title: Change the details on a charitable fundraising authority
summary: This page provides information on how to change the details associated with a charitable fundraising authority.
who_can_apply: You must be the holder of a charitable fundraising authority or be authorized by the authority holder.
what_you_need: Your charitable fundraising authority number (CFN) which must match the registered number.
Details of the contact person, name, or address.
The charitable purpose for which the appeal is being or is to be conducted.
Details of any branches, whether commencing or ceasing.
Details of your auditor, whether commencing or ceasing.
Details of your traders, whether commencing or ceasing.
Confirmation if you decide to stop fundraising under the authority.
Confirmation if your Australian Charities and Not-for-Profits Commission (ACNC) registration is revoked or suspended.

how_to_steps.text: You'll have the option to log in using your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change the details.
Download Charitable fundraising authority – change of details – PDF.
Email your information to the address on the form.

contact: If you have any questions about a charitable fundraising authority email NSW Fair Trading or call 13 32 20.

more_info.text: For more information go to the NSW Fair Trading Charitable Fundraising Guidelines.

external_links.text: Charitable fundraising authority – change of details – PDF

internal_links.text: Lodge an annual return for a charitable fundraising authority

faqs.q: Who can change the details on a charitable fundraising authority?
faqs.a: You must be the holder of a charitable fundraising authority or be authorized by the authority holder.

faqs.q: How can I change my charitable fundraising authority details?
faqs.a: You can change the details by selecting the 'Change online' button and logging in using your MyServiceNSW Account, or by completing and submitting the required form.
